This file is for doing ata import.

```{r echo = F}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read_csv(file = "data/FAS_litters.csv", skip = 0)
litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import second dataset.

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv("data/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3)
pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at the data

```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

## Head and tail
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)
tail(pups_df, 5)
```

skimming?
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
